we have shown the feasibility of a hybrid integration approach for flexible electronic systems on foil substrates.

the presented approach of a hybrid heterointegration of thin silicon chips with printed electronic components, actuators and sensors on flexible foil substrate is a cost efficient approach for large area systems.
